Vaginal pH can indeed be measured directly from a wet mount slide. This method involves collecting a sample of vaginal fluid and bringing it into contact with a pH strip to obtain an estimate of the vaginal pH. This approach is often used in clinical settings as a simple and rapid way to assess vaginal acidity.

To perform this test, follow these steps:

1. Collect a vaginal discharge or fluid by inserting a cotton swab or tampon into the vagina.
2. Bring the sample into contact with a pH strip.
3. Read the pH reading on the strip.

It's essential to note that this method may not provide accurate results in all cases and should be used as part of a comprehensive diagnostic evaluation.
